layout_and_spacing.marketing_grid: Bento 'Tetris' grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Asymmetrical spans.
layout_and_spacing.dashboard_grid: Control Room grid. grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4. High density, pure black backgrounds, 1px white/10 borders.

surfaces.marketing_cards: Flat background with 1px border-white/10. Optional 'Tracing Beam' effect on feature highlights. No soft shadows.
surfaces.dashboard_cards: Flat solid #121212, 1px border-border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and border-white/20.
surfaces.header_nav: Crystal glassmorphism: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10.
surfaces.ai_chat_bubble: User: bg-white/10 text-white. AI: bg-[#1A1A1A] text-white border border-[#FF3B30]/30 shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(255,59,48,0.1)].

components.buttons: Sharp corners. Primary: bg-[#FF3B30] text-white font-bold hover:bg-[#FF5C53] transition-colors. Secondary: transparent border border-white/20 hover:border-white text-white.
components.inputs: bg-[#121212] border-white/10 text-white focus:ring-1 focus:ring-[#FF3B30] focus:border-[#FF3B30] rounded-none md:rounded-sm
components.charts: Recharts. Transparent background. Data lines in neon red (#FF3B30) or cyan (#00FFFF). Minimal grid lines (white/5).
components.icons: Use @phosphor-icons/react (Bold or Duotone). Avoid thin/delicate icons.

image_urls.description: Dark moody gym background with man on weight bench
Neon grid/abstract network for AI tech section

animation_and_motion.page_load: Framer Motion staggered fade-up for grids and lists.
animation_and_motion.hover_states: ALWAYS explicitly set text color on hover. Example: hover:bg-[#FF3B30] hover:text-white

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building an AI-powered gym website in Turkish. Ensure all UI text is in Turkish.
CRITICAL: Use pure HTML + Tailwind CSS for marketing page layouts. Do not use Shadcn 'Card' components for the landing page.
CRITICAL: Use customized Shadcn UI components for complex interactions like Forms, Modals, Inputs, Tables, Tabs, and the Dashboard interface.
CRITICAL: DO NOT USE PURPLE or TEAL colors anywhere.
CRITICAL: Include `data-testid` attributes on ALL interactive and key informational elements using kebab-case role-based names (e.g., data-testid='workout-generate-button').
CRITICAL: Apply a dark overlay (bg-black/60) to hero images to ensure the massive Bebas Neue text is perfectly legible.
Follow 'Tactical Minimalism' - rely on 1px borders instead of heavy box-shadows. Use Electric Blaze (#FF3B30) for CTAs and focus states.
Ensure contrast ratios meet APCA standards. Never use pure #000000, tint it slightly with blue (e.g., #0A0A0A).
